Briefly, Iodoacetamide (Sigma I1149) was conjugated to 4SU in a 50mM pH 8.0 phosphate buffer in DMSO/Water (1:1), the reaction was quenched with DTT and RNA was reprecipitated using Ethanol and NaOAc.
